recognize_zh: 這是次世代定序（Archer FusionPlex RNA 融合檢測）的 JBrowse 截圖：大量讀序（reads）連續跨越 TRAF1 外顯子與 ALK 外顯子 20 的交界，代表 TRAF1-ALK 融合，是 NPM1 以外的變異型 ALK 夥伴基因。
features: Genome browser (JBrowse) view of an RNA-based fusion panel (Archer FusionPlex) contig
Annotation tracks show TRAF1 exon sequence (red arrow) juxtaposed to ALK exon 20 (black arrow) within one contig
High read coverage (about 3,000 reads) spanning the junction, supporting a true fusion transcript
Stacked aligned reads in the lower panel with only sporadic mismatches
describe_en: The figure is a genome browser screenshot from an RNA-based targeted next-generation sequencing fusion assay. The assembled contig contains TRAF1 exon sequence (red arrow) contiguous with ALK exon 20 (black arrow), and the junction is supported by deep read coverage of approximately 3,000 reads, indicating an in-frame TRAF1-ALK fusion transcript that retains the ALK kinase domain. TRAF1 is a rare, non-NPM1 ALK partner; because the fusion protein lacks the NPM1 nuclear localization domain, ALK immunostaining is expected to be cytoplasmic without nuclear staining. The result supports a diagnosis of ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context.
